summary: Monitors a resource's state: reads the resource handle at this+0xE0, dereferences a state value at the resource object +0x2C, and compares it against the cached value at this+0xE4. When the state differs, updates the cache, calls ProfileIconPathSetter(this), and notifies through the vtable at this+0 (method at offset +44) with argument 1. Returns 0 in all paths.

operations.description: Guard on the resource handle at this + 0xE0 (this[56]): if null, skip all state monitoring and return 0.
Read the fresh resource state value from the resource object at obj + 0x2C.
Compare the cached value at this + 0xE4 (this[57]) against the fresh state; when equal, skip the update and notification.
Update the cached state this + 0xE4 (this[57]) to the fresh resource state.
Call ProfileIconPathSetter(this) after the cache is updated.
Notify through the vtable at this + 0: call the __thiscall method at vtable offset +44 with argument 1.

unresolved: Evidence lists a read of this + 0x254, but no visible operation in the raw source consumes it; its role is unknown.
Semantics of the state value at obj + 0x2C and of the notify argument (1) are unknown.
Identity of the vtable method at offset +44 is unknown.
